rationale: The release note is a vulnerability-detection milestone. The language guide requires one supported AppDynamics dual-mode installation and one security signal path, scopes it to active AWS realms with Secure Application and excludes GCP. It does not enumerate exact AWS realm IDs or establish authorization. The current Observability service realm mapping and February compliance rows remain separate evidence. An official historical announcement describes pursuing Moderate rather than an awarded offering.
